gates.description: Research question must be written in canonical format with the decision it informs
Research method must be selected with justification based on the question type
Findings, insights, and recommendations must be clearly distinguished
Patterns must be validated across 3+ participants — single observations are anecdotes
Confidence level must be assigned to each insight (high/medium/low)
Recommendations must be actionable and specific, linked to product decisions

anti_patterns.description: Sending a survey for every research question — surveys measure what you already suspect, not what you don't know to ask
Designing research to prove a pre-existing belief — leading questions, biased participant selection, selective reporting
Conducting research, producing a report, and filing it away — if research does not change a decision, it was waste
Building personas around age, gender, and job title instead of behavior, motivation, and context
Testing with 30 users when 6 would suffice for qualitative insight — more participants dilutes attention per session
Only conducting research in controlled lab settings — real users work in noisy offices and get interrupted

escalation_triggers: Research reveals a fundamental misalignment between product direction and actual user needs
Stakeholders are making decisions that directly contradict research findings without acknowledging the risk
Team lacks access to real users and PM is unwilling to pursue recruitment channels
Ethical concerns arise during research (participant distress, privacy violations, deceptive practices)
Two research studies produce contradictory findings that cannot be reconciled
Research timelines are being compressed to the point where data quality is at risk

input_requirements.description: PRD.md with product questions and hypotheses to validate

output_certifications: Research question written in canonical format with the decision it informs
Method selected with justification based on question type
Findings, insights, and recommendations clearly distinguished
Confidence level assigned to each insight (high/medium/low)
Recommendations are actionable, specific, and linked to product decisions
